one_liner: Airtable has a broad REST Web API with self-serve OAuth2 and personal access tokens, free-plan access (1,000 calls/month cap), and an official MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code integrations are registered self-serve at /create/oauth. Personal access tokens (sent as Bearer) cover single-user use. Legacy API keys were shut down on Feb 1, 2024. Using an OAuth integration beyond development requires a Terms of Service URL, Support Email and Privacy Policy URL.
access_notes: PATs are available on all plans. The Free plan can use all Base Data endpoints except Views, with a limit of 1,000 calls per workspace per month. Enterprise API endpoints require Enterprise Scale.
blocker_notes: The free-plan call cap (1,000/month) and the 5 requests/sec per-base rate limit are operational constraints, not blockers.

evidence.quote: We currently support using personal access tokens and OAuth access tokens during the authentication process.
You can access the OAuth integrations panel at [/create/oauth](https://airtable.com/create/oauth). From here you can register new integrations
Access to all "Base Data" endpoints except "Views"
**Free** plan - 1000 calls per workspace per month
Airtable enforces a rate limit of 5 requests per second](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/rate-limits) (per base)
Airtable's MCP server lets you connect AI tools directly to your Airtable bases.
